title: Sony Centre Fury celebrate SBC Playoff title
description: Sony Centre Fury conquered the SBC Playoff title. They outgunned Boroughmuir Blaze 84-57 in the Final tonight. Sony Centre Fury recorded a comfortable 48-30 halftime lead. They held the Blaze to just 9 points in the third quarter and never looked back en route to the win. Murray Hendry (204-C-1995) posted 18 points, 15 assists and 5 rebounds for the champions. He was named the MVP.
imageCaption: Sony Centre Fury celebrate SBC Playoff title (Photo: SBC)

title: Sony Centre Fury are 2024 Senior Men Playoff Champions!
description: Sony Centre Fury are 2024 Senior Men Playoff Champions in Scotland! They edged St Mirren 93-64 in the Final game. After a tough 18-17 start, Sony Centre Fury took full control of the game. They erupted with a massive run to take a 50-25 halftime advantage. Fury led 71-45 after three quarters and easily clinched the win at the end.
imageCaption: Sony Centre Fury are 2024 Senior Men Playoff Champions!

title: Boroughmuir Blaze celebrate SBC title
description: Boroughmuir Blaze earned 22/23 SBC title. They swept Sony Centre Fury in the championship series. The Blaze posted a 79-76 victory in Game 2 of the Finals to conquer the trophy. It was another close battle in the Finals. But Blaze came out on top once again and earned the trophy.

title: Sony Centre Fury clinch Cup title 2022
description: Sony Centre Fury clinched Cup title 2022 in Scotland. They overcame Dunfermline Reign 68-63 in a thriller. Despite a fight from Mirren, it was Sony Centre Fury who come away with the victory. They led 36-29 heading into the 3rd quarter. No matter how hard Reign tried to recover, they managed to reduce to final 5 points.
